observations.unknown: No isolated rear-face photograph or measured orthogonal profile obtained. Inner reflector/socket, hidden seam thickness, vent/drain and attachment details unresolved.

observations.visible: Dark matte stem includes short annular flex-groove region near lamp plus broader elongated sleeve/base. Silver hexagonal mounting hardware at cable end; portion of threaded stud clearer in DM201027 related photo.
observations.unknown: Material grade/hardness, full rear interface and lengths, M10 pitch/AF and fit exactRDC unknown. Nominal M10 is not an external scale bar; do not scale lens or stem from projected hexnut.
